⭐ The Engineering team ⭐

In our engineering team, we build the infrastructure, interfaces, and applications to provide first-class service to our members, health professionals, and even ourselves!

Being an engineer at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate engineers, with a lot of interactions.

We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

Our process is very simple: those who make product decisions are the same ones who build them.

Want to know more? Read this article on our Engineering career path.

🛠️ The Stack

Python/Flask, Typescript, React, React Native on the coding side. AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Redis, Terraform/Terramate, Datadog, Cloudflare, GitHub Actions on the platform side, all in a monorepo. We deploy daily and believe in distributed ownership - you build it, you own it.

🤖 The Infra Crew - within the Tech Foundations area

🎯 Mission:

  • Tech Foundations - enables product crews and creates the environment to thrive, combining world-class infrastructure, intuitive developer experience, exquisite operational excellence, and built-in security to make shipping exceptional products effortless.

  • Infra - is one of its crews. Its mission: operate and evolve the foundations Alan runs on (multi-cloud infrastructure, data platforms, observability, and the operational practices around them) so that product crews ship safely and quickly, members never feel the platform underneath, and the business can expand to new countries without re-inventing how we run.

🔭 Scope:

  1. Cloud foundations & multi-cloud architecture: own and evolve Alan’s cloud footprint, Infrastructure-as-Code stack (Terraform, Terramate), and the architectural decisions enabling international expansion.

  2. Data & application platforms: operate and evolve the foundations product crews build on: PostgreSQL/Aurora, our events pipeline, async workloads, and database migration tooling, without leaking complexity into product code.

  3. Reliability, observability & on-call: own Alan's platform uptime and latency SLOs end-to-end. Evolve our observability stack (Datadog), the incident response process (Incident.io), and the shared on-call rotation across the area to keep it sustainable as we scale.

  4. Governance & compliance enablement and FinOps: own the cross-cutting concerns no single domain holds, infrastructure cost (FinOps), IAM posture, backup and disaster recovery, exit strategy, with automation and reporting that scales beyond the crew.

  5. AI-augmented infrastructure operations: make AI assistants a first-class citizen for incident investigation, runbook execution, and toil reduction, so engineers spend their time on high-leverage work.

👀 Focus for 2026:

In 2026, we're growing the team significantly to step up impact across four bets:

  • Multi-cloud expansion: revisit our cloud strategy as we go international, and launch new geographies.

  • Decoupling for scale: evolve service architecture to carry Alan 2.0 from 1M members today to 10M.

  • Operational excellence: raise the quality bar end-to-end by overhauling observability, on-call, and cost management practices.

  • AI-augmented infra ops: make AI assistants a first-class part of investigation, troubleshooting, and toil reduction, so engineers spend time where leverage is highest.

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

Experience we value

  • 3+ years in Platform engineering, DevOps, Site reliability engineering or equivalent roles.

  • You have strong experience with cloud platforms (especially AWS or GCP).

  • You're comfortable writing code for automation and tooling (e.g. API, internal command line, developer portal) and willing to work in Python/Typescript (but you don’t need to have experience with those 2 languages!).

  • You have touched observability, monitoring, alerting or incident management tools and practices.

  • You are able to design and implement robust infrastructure systems with a focus on reliability and observability.

  • You can maintain our uptime targets while optimizing infrastructure costs.

  • You’ve built and maintained internal or external tooling (e.g. API, web interface, internal command line, configuration as code, etc) for other engineers.

Mindset we value

  • You treat infrastructure and platform engineering as product work: engineers & members are your customers, and infrastructure should feel effortless.

  • You’re hands-on: writing code is the bulk of the job (Python, TypeScript, Terraform). You ship what you write to production yourself, then operate it: rollouts, alerting, on-call, incident response.

  • You're an enabler: you measure your impact by how fast product crews ship features without ever consulting you. The harder you've worked, the less they have to engage you.

  • You build reusable patterns: guardrails, libraries, and reliable-by-default abstractions that prevent outages and runaway cost at scale.

  • You’re fluent in English (French is not required).

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire above C1 level range.

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus.

🌍 How we work

  • Location: You must be legally eligible to work in France, Belgium, or Spain.

  • Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

You want to know more about Alan?

  • 🤘 A strong culture: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work

HEALTH CAN’T WAIT.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


⭐ THE ENGINEERING TEAM ⭐

In our engineering team, we build the infrastructure, interfaces, and applications to provide first-class service to our members, health professionals, and even ourselves!

Being an engineer at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate engineers, with a lot of interactions.

We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

Our process is very simple: those who make product decisions are the same ones who build them.

Want to know more? Read this article https://medium.com/alan/a-new-iteration-of-our-engineering-career-path-at-alan-f46f7b229b2d on our Engineering career path.




🛠️ THE STACK

Python/Flask, Typescript, React, React Native on the coding side. AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Redis, Terraform/Terramate, Datadog, Cloudflare, GitHub Actions on the platform side, all in a monorepo. We deploy daily and believe in distributed ownership - you build it, you own it.




🤖 THE INFRA CREW - WITHIN THE TECH FOUNDATIONS AREA

🎯 Mission:

 - Tech Foundations - enables product crews and creates the environment to thrive, combining world-class infrastructure, intuitive developer experience, exquisite operational excellence, and built-in security to make shipping exceptional products effortless.

 - Infra - is one of its crews. Its mission: operate and evolve the foundations Alan runs on (multi-cloud infrastructure, data platforms, observability, and the operational practices around them) so that product crews ship safely and quickly, members never feel the platform underneath, and the business can expand to new countries without re-inventing how we run.

🔭 Scope:

 1. Cloud foundations & multi-cloud architecture: own and evolve Alan’s cloud footprint, Infrastructure-as-Code stack (Terraform, Terramate), and the architectural decisions enabling international expansion.

 2. Data & application platforms: operate and evolve the foundations product crews build on: PostgreSQL/Aurora, our events pipeline, async workloads, and database migration tooling, without leaking complexity into product code.

 3. Reliability, observability & on-call: own Alan's platform uptime and latency SLOs end-to-end. Evolve our observability stack (Datadog), the incident response process (Incident.io http://Incident.io), and the shared on-call rotation across the area to keep it sustainable as we scale.

 4. Governance & compliance enablement and FinOps: own the cross-cutting concerns no single domain holds, infrastructure cost (FinOps), IAM posture, backup and disaster recovery, exit strategy, with automation and reporting that scales beyond the crew.

 5. AI-augmented infrastructure operations: make AI assistants a first-class citizen for incident investigation, runbook execution, and toil reduction, so engineers spend their time on high-leverage work.

👀 Focus for 2026:

In 2026, we're growing the team significantly to step up impact across four bets:

 - Multi-cloud expansion: revisit our cloud strategy as we go international, and launch new geographies.

 - Decoupling for scale: evolve service architecture to carry Alan 2.0 from 1M members today to 10M.

 - Operational excellence: raise the quality bar end-to-end by overhauling observability, on-call, and cost management practices.

 - AI-augmented infra ops: make AI assistants a first-class part of investigation, troubleshooting, and toil reduction, so engineers spend time where leverage is highest.




⭐ IS IT YOU WE’RE LOOKING FOR?




EXPERIENCE WE VALUE

 - 3+ years in Platform engineering, DevOps, Site reliability engineering or equivalent roles.

 - You have strong experience with cloud platforms (especially AWS or GCP).

 - You're comfortable writing code for automation and tooling (e.g. API, internal command line, developer portal) and willing to work in Python/Typescript (but you don’t need to have experience with those 2 languages!).

 - You have touched observability, monitoring, alerting or incident management tools and practices.

 - You are able to design and implement robust infrastructure systems with a focus on reliability and observability.

 - You can maintain our uptime targets while optimizing infrastructure costs.

 - You’ve built and maintained internal or external tooling (e.g. API, web interface, internal command line, configuration as code, etc) for other engineers.


MINDSET WE VALUE

 - You treat infrastructure and platform engineering as product work: engineers & members are your customers, and infrastructure should feel effortless.

 - You’re hands-on: writing code is the bulk of the job (Python, TypeScript, Terraform). You ship what you write to production yourself, then operate it: rollouts, alerting, on-call, incident response.

 - You're an enabler: you measure your impact by how fast product crews ship features without ever consulting you. The harder you've worked, the less they have to engage you.

 - You build reusable patterns: guardrails, libraries, and reliable-by-default abstractions that prevent outages and runaway cost at scale.

 - You’re fluent in English (French is not required).

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire above C1 level range https://medium.com/alan/a-new-iteration-of-our-engineering-career-path-at-alan-f46f7b229b2d.

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus.




🌍 HOW WE WORK

 - Location: You must be legally eligible to work in France, Belgium, or Spain.

 - Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration


🎯 IMPORTANT NOTE: WE HIRE PEOPLE, NOT ROLES.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan https://alan.com/about and Career https://alan.com/careers pages, as well as our Medium https://medium.com/alan, blog https://blog.alan.com/ and Glassdoor page https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working-at-Alan-EI_IE1696043.11,15.htm for more info.




YOU WANT TO KNOW MORE ABOUT ALAN?

 - 🙌 Perks & Benefits https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity: Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

 - 🤘 A strong culture https://alan.com/en/about/a/leadership-principles: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Insurance Team ⭐️

Being part of Alan's insurance community is a great opportunity to have a significant impact on people's health and wellbeing in our multiple countries of operation.

  • We are at the heart of Alan’s mission, bringing to the team our technical leadership and expertise on healthcare and death & disability insurance.

  • We work hand in hand with our data scientists, designers, engineers and product managers to build the most differentiating products and provide a delightful experience at a fair price.

  • We build and manage offers for large companies and public institutions with our sales and account management teams.

  • We make sure our portfolio is closely monitored and risks are effectively managed.

  • We also manage our capital, steer our reinsurance strategy and maintain a trusting relationship with our insurance regulators.

⭐️ Your role ⭐️ ️

As Alan’s Risk Expert, you will be in charge of providing Alan with automated and scalable risk assessment tools:

  • Risk modeling

    • You will be in charge of strengthening and automating the building our Solvency 2 balance sheet and capital requirements projections, covering both health, death and disability business lines

    • You will model new risks when they arise (new insurance products, branches, international, investment etc.)

    • You will challenge our risk appetite, propose new relevant risk metrics and build tools to monitor them

    • You will support the board meetings preparation and communication with investors regarding capital evolution and market risks

  • Regulatory

    • You will scale and automate the production of our regulatory quantitative reporting and contribute to our narrative (SFCR, RSR) and ORSA reports

    • You will support our discussions with supervisors

    • You will assist the assessment of international opportunities and help prepare the opening of new countries

  • Capital management

    • You will make proposals to improve our capital management in the 4 countries Alan is present

    • You will manage our reinsurance strategy, to find an optimum between solvency and profitability, negotiating with reinsurance partners, and analyze reinsurance reporting

  • Team Growth

    • You will create processes and resources to strengthen the team’s ability to understand our risk and capital constraints

    • You will support the identification and hiring of new talents for the Insurance and Risk teams.

⭐️ Is it you we’re looking for? ⭐️

You would thrive in this role if you:

  • Have at last 8 years of experience in Solvency 2 regulatory framework, especially for S2 accounting, with knowledge of Health, Life and Market risks as a bonus

  • Are fluent in English and in French for regulatory interactions

  • Possess excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, including data analysis capabilities

  • Can automate processes and build new tools, with programming skills being a plus

  • Bring rigor and reliability to reporting production while working independently in a fast-paced environment

  • Have strong communication skills for effective interaction with internal and external stakeholders

  • Are confident learning new tools, technologies, and methodologies with creative problem-solving approaches

For this position, we are looking to hire someone within the E-F level.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - ****it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🎯 The mission & impact

Our system defines what Insurance coverage (health or life & disability) our members get, with a high level of customization:

  • We equip our Sales team with tools to craft these offers, price them, and contractualize them in one go. We also power our self-serve subscription flow.

  • Over time, we manage our contract lifecycles, making sure they are always up-to-date in terms of legal requirements and responsible consumption best practices, and at equilibrium in terms of loss ratio.

  • Alan's claim engine, billing system and many other part of our stack relies on the offers we build to deliver a pristine experience to our members.

🚀 What you'll build and who you’ll work with

  • Next-Gen Healthcare Framework: 4 countries (and more to come), multiple products (Insurance but also several other healthcare products) but one system. Come build the contract & service stack that will power Alan’s growth for the next 10 years.

  • AI-powered Acquisition Engine: Sales teams are autonomous & assisted by AI to customize coverage, compute pricing, and generate contracts in real-time. No need for actuaries, no more waiting days for quotes.

  • Automated Renewal System: Automatically reviews and adjusts coverage for our entire portfolio annually, accounting for legal changes, consumption trends, and economic shifts.

You'll work closely with insurance experts, business specialist, sales teams, and collaborate with other eng teams across Alan. We're the bridge between complex regulations and simple user experiences.

⚡ Why this role is special

  • Direct Impact: Your decisions affect Alan’s scaling, growth, profitability and ability to provide easy access to healthcare to more and more people.

  • Complex Problems: Modelling a complex world in a simple stack, real-time pricing, scale challenges

  • Ownership & Growth: Influence product direction, mentor other engineers, and lead technical initiatives that shape the future of healthcare access

🛠️ The Stack

Python/Flask, React, PostgreSQL in a monorepo. We deploy daily and believe in distributed ownership - you build it, you own it.

🔍 What we're looking for

Technical Requirements:

  • 3+ years building scalable backend systems

  • Experience with high-traffic applications that real users depend on

What we value:

  • You love turning complex problems into elegant solutions

  • You care about the "why" behind what you build, not just the "how"

  • Clear progression in your career - increasing responsibility, scope, and impact over time

Mission Alignment:

  • Healthcare technology excites you

  • You understand that insurance isn't just about money - it's about access to care

⭐ The Engineering team ⭐

In our engineering team, we build the infrastructure, interfaces, and applications to provide first-class service to our members, health professionals, and even ourselves!

Being an engineer at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate engineers, with a lot of product interaction.

We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

Our process is very simple: those who make product decisions are the same ones who build them.

Our stack is React, Python/Flask, PostgreSQL in a monorepo. If you are not familiar with this stack but are a keen learner, it is totally fine. We deploy daily and believe in distributed ownership - you build it, you own it.

Want to know more? Read this article if you want to discover how life as an Engineer at Alan and this article on our Engineering career path.

🌍 How we work

Location: You must be legally eligible to work in France, Belgium, or Spain.

Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration. We are looking for people who want to help people live in good health to 100 while helping employers turn health benefits from a cost center into their most valuable investment..

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor pages for more info.

You want to know more about Alan?

  • 🙌 Perks & Benefits: Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

  • 🤘 A strong culture: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work

Note: While you're applying for Insurance Offer, you may join a different engineering team based on where we think you'll have the most impact. Check out descriptions of other areas here.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ YOUR MISSION ⭐️


Taking care of our clients is at the heart of our business. Our User Care Experts are on the frontline to answer our members (via chat, email and phone), solve their problems and offer an amazing customer experience.

  • Helping our members - Your first mission will be to deal with our members' requests in a meaningful, delightful and timely manner. Your goal is to be transparent, accurate, clear and helpful to our members. After all, we are dealing with a crucial subject — their health — and we are committed to offering them exceptional service.

  • Improving Alan - As a User Care Expert, you’ll also have the opportunity to work on projects next to answering our members. The focus of these projects depends on your interest and background.  We expect you to help us implement better processes and tools, and to contribute to improving our product. This will involve analysing what you see, identifying areas for improvement and making suggestions on what we can do better.

  • Grow and learn - At Alan, we are dedicated to learn as much as we can. It's not every day that you can join a fast-growing company, tackling an obsolete sector by putting the member at the heart of it all. You will become an expert in healthcare and insurance, and help new members of the great healthcare team.

  • Pioneering - The 🇧🇪 care team today is still relatively small. However, we have bold ambitions and will grow quickly. You will be involved in building, nurturing and enhancing our care team on a daily basis.

 

⭐️ JOIN THE 🇧🇪 CARE TEAM ⭐️ 

You will be a good fit for the role if you:

  • Have 2+ years of experience in: a customer-support role; or education; or communication

  • Are bilingual English + Dutch OR English + French❗️

  • Have a passion for caring for members, and solving their problems

  • Love written communication

  • Are comfortable with computers and technology in general

  • Have a very empathetic mindset

  • Are motivated and entrepreneurial

  • Have an enthusiasm for teamwork, learning and teaching  

  • Bonus points if you know how the Belgian healthcare system works — we will teach you if you don’t. 😉  

Everything else you know is a plus! We want our team to be made up of a diversity of experiences and backgrounds.

Good to know:

  • For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire full time and within the A1-B1 level range.

  • Insurance is a regulated profession and requires all agents in contact with the public to pass a basic insurance knowledge test within their first year of exercise (some exemptions apply). This exam is covered by Alan ; reach out to us to know more!

🌍 How we work

  • Location: You must be legally eligible to work from Belgium or France.

  • Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration

     

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

 

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

 

You want to know more about Alan?

🙌 Perks & Benefits: Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

🤘A strong culture: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work

Alan exists to end the wait.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🤹 Operations at Alan

Our Operations team guarantees the delivery at scale of our insurance and healthcare products, efficiently and delightfully.

This means:

  • Bringing the ops perspective into Alan strategy

  • Building our organisation and processes to deliver the vision to allow further disruption and product diversification

  • Monitoring and running those processes internally or externally on a daily basis

  • Scaling efficiently and industrializing our operational stack to handle fast growth, international expansion and cost optimisation

We handle complex projects in constant interactions with multidisciplinary teams (Product & Design, Engineering, Data, Customer Support, Finance, etc.)

You’ll be joining 30+ talented, committed, passionate Ops team members from five different countries. As we grow, expand and diversify our business our operations are becoming ever more complex and our challenges ahead have never been as exciting!

Want to learn more about Ops at Alan? Read how we work and hire and watch our team in action

⭐️ The challenges

We are looking for entrepreneurs in the mindset wishing to disrupt (and not only upgrade) the way we traditionally think about insurance or healthcare. Our goal is to deeply re-engineer the experience we offer to our members .

We move fast and are proud to tackle big problems! One of our core value is ownership : we expect you to tackle Alan's problems from end to end with a long-term focus, acting on the behalf of the entire Company, never saying “it’s not my job” and being accountable for your actions.

 

Here are some examples of missions you could contribute to:

  • Scaling psychotherapy online sessions: Defining the operating model from scratch, making hard resourcing decisions under uncertainty, managing quality at scale, and driving international replication. Today: 80,000 sessions were delivered & 93% of users report reduced stress.

  • Saving millions through fraud detection: Building a detection capability with no playbook. Owning make-vs-buy decisions on tooling, balancing precision against member experience at scale, and managing the external surface. Partner negotiations, industry lobbying, and ecosystem-level fraud strategy.

  • Reinventing healthcare expense payment: Challenging a key French health insurance item (Tiers Payant), owning complex supplier negotiations autonomously, and cutting the budget line by more than half while improving member satisfaction.

⭐️ If you have some of the following, you may be a great fit ⭐️

  • You have at least 2 years of professional experience in Operations management or entrepreneurship

  • You are fully fluent in English and Spanish/French/Dutch

  • You have a high level of structure and strong analytical skills (including Sql fluency for data analysis)

  • You are capable of building automations (Zapier, n8n…)

  • You excel at launching and steering projects by setting the high level vision and monitoring the day to day progress

  • You are strong at optimizing processes while never compromising with members’ delight

  • You are comfortable in fast-paced environments: you know how to deal with uncertainty, remaining proactive and focused on efficiency

  • You love to collaborate with transversal teams, not afraid to be hands-on nor to challenge past decisions.

For this role we are looking to hire within the B1-D level range based out of France, Belgium or Spain.

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🚀 The Challenge 🚀

Ensuring a smooth onboarding journey to key accounts and provide ongoing support throughout their partnership with Alan.

The operational onboarding manager is accountable for operational excellence and long-term satisfaction of our most strategic accounts. They play a critical role as Alan continue expanding Enterprise and Public sector partnerships.

Scaling the role's process and support. We will need to design new guidelines & processes as we move forward, to scale this customized approach to onboarding!

👩‍💻 Helping Our Admins

Your primary mission is to ensure operational excellence and an outstanding admin experience across a portfolio of key accounts (5 to 10 accounts per onboarding manager). You'll be the go-to expert for complex admin topics such as affiliations, payroll management, invoicing, and billing—delivering meaningful, proactive, and delightful support while building deep expertise along the way.

You will:

  • Train and onboard admins on Alan's product, workflows, and best practices (remote and occasionally onsite): affiliation lifecycle, payroll management, invoicing, and more

  • Own admin support end-to-end for your account portfolio: handle requests, investigate issues, coordinate with internal teams, and ensure timely resolution

  • Manage complex or sensitive conversations with admins (objections, escalations, high-stakes operational topics) with clarity and empathy

  • Anticipate risks (missing affiliations, payroll edge cases, invoicing issues) and prevent blockers before they impact admins

👷 Building the role in Belgium

All onboarding managers actively contribute to improving Alan beyond their day-to-day support work. You'll help shape the function itself—designing processes, playbooks, and ways of working that will scale as we grow.

You will:

  • Identify recurring pain points and propose improvements: documentation, playbooks, tooling, and product feedback (with Product Specialists and relevant crews)

  • Contribute to team priorities depending on the period: process/tooling projects, knowledge sharing, and occasionally hiring-related work

  • Report on operations at the company level to ensure visibility on opportunities derived from admin insights

  • Collaborate closely with Key Account Managers, Pre-Sales, Customer Success Managers, and Operations to remove blockers, coordinate resolutions, and surface product/process improvements

🔍 Profile & skills

Soft Skills:

  • Demonstrate strong ownership and autonomy on their missions

  • Demonstrate growth mindset, challenges positively, learn fast

  • Demonstrate strong client-facing posture and communicate effectively both internally and with admins. At ease to train small group of several people/go onsite to meet our members

  • Able to embrace change, have collaborative mindset

  • Good listening skills, empathy and pedagogic skills.

  • At ease with complex conversation and/or admin conversations.

Hard Skills:

  • Excellent and structured written & oral communication skills in both Dutch and English ❗️

  • Excellent problem-solving skills.: able to structure a problem, identify relevant solutions

  • Great organization skills / Time management skills: is comfortable facing several competing priorities autonomously

Experience:

  • Customer-Facing Experience: Previous experience in BtoB customer-facing roles, such as Customer Success, teaching, or communication.

  • Autonomous, driven, can organize themselves well (comfortable in our fast-paced environment), missionary

  • At ease with complex / new topics (experience in complex environments, strong studies…)

  • [Opportunistic] Exceptional profiles with sales-facing roles experience (e.g. Account executive, Sales) are also part of the scope

⭐ Join The Care Team as Onboarding Manager! ⭐️

You will thrive at Alan if you:

  • Have a genuine passion for helping others and find joy in solving member challenges

  • Master Dutch and English at a full working proficiency level (written and spoken)

  • Navigate technology with confidence and embrace digital tools

  • Feel at ease connecting with members across all channels - email, visio call, and phone calls

  • Bring natural empathy and a calm presence to every interaction

  • Love taking initiative and turning ideas into action

  • Thrive in collaborative environments where you can both learn and share knowledge

  • Bonus: Already understand the Belgian healthcare system (but don't worry if you don't - we're great teachers! 😉)

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire full time and within the B0-C0 level range

🌍 How we work

  • Location: You must be legally eligible to work from France.

  • Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration

     

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

  • Owning the entire monitoring scheme to track volumes/efficiency/SLAs, and identify risks and areas of improvement, internally or with our service providers

  • Managing the monthly billing process for all Alan Canada customers, including identifying the strategy to cover complex payroll cases

You’ll be lucky enough to experiment a scrappy and thriving start-up environment while being part of a fluid global powerhouse to back you up.

  • You have at least 2-3 years of experience in a fast paced environment (start-up and scale-ups where you have to wear multiple hats is preferred)

  • You are a keen problem-solver and challenger with a dig deep mindset: what drives you is member and customer satisfaction !

  • You are highly organised with exceptional follow-up skills, with strong attention to details

  • You are able to work and learn independently in a fast-paced environment

  • It’s even better if you have:

    • Experience in the healthcare insurance or Saas industry

    • Some analytics skills, to be able to dive into our data

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the A2-B1 salary range.

  • In office: amazing office space right in the heart of the financial district (King & Yonge) to work closely and collaboratively with your colleagues 4-5 days per week in-person!

  • GRRSP. Generous employer matching program!

⚡ The Inbound Sales 🇫🇷 role

We're growing our Inbound Sales team in France.

Our Inbound Sales team is in charge of closing inbound requests from leads with 1 to 5 employees (Independent workers, very small companies, individuals).

You’ll be in charge of the whole sales cycle from qualification to closing by educating prospects and providing inspiring arguments to transform them into convinced customers.

At the same time, we expect you to understand, embrace and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method stems from the concept that the prospect experience is an inseparable piece of the overall Alan customer experience. You are expected to make this experience pleasant, instructive and delightful by leveraging the most relevant messaging and materials (Smart) and by defining the high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

We also expect you to look at the big picture and help us grow and improve as a company. For that, you’ll have to be real team players even beyond your role. You’ll be expected to challenge us to improve our product(s), our methods, and our strategy, and get involved in other projects and initiatives relevant to growing our customer base.

What does make this role exciting :

  • You will close deals every single day of the year, which is very stimulating!

  • The Inbound Sales team is quite recent: You will contribute to building a new practice within the Sales Community, getting involved in tooling and process improvements

  • You will help building the playbook of best practices to close deals in one shot

  • You will contribute to making our products even better by sharing feedback and improving the self-serve experience for our members

  • You will become an insurance expert and learn to master our products in order to confidently answer questions & objections from prospects

  • We invest heavily in AI to transform the Sales practice. You'll have the opportunity to become one of the most modern Sales professionals in the market!

⭐ You will be a great fit for this role if you: 

  • Have 1-2 years of experience in a Sales role including closing experience

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above), and advanced level in English

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills

  • Show a great balance between Active Listening and Assertiveness when interacting with your prospects

  • Have natural empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems

  • Have a positive attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team

  • Have a desire to learn fast and make an impact from day 1

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the A2-B1 level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles. 

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

jobs.title: Founding engineer- Mo team (AI Health Companion)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
🤖 Who we are

We’re building Mo — a health companion for everyone.

We’re a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise. We are building Mo, an intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up on care.

Imagine giving every person in the world instant, 24/7 access to personalised medical expertise - through chat, voice, or video. That’s what we are building 🤖.

We kicked off the project in 2023, and we have launched Mo to all our french members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe.

🚀 What keeps us up at night

We’re building a medical agent that works — reliably, safely, and at scale.

You’ll work at the intersection of product engineering, ML engineering, and medical expertise. Our mission is to build the most accurate and reliable medical agent in the world, while delivering an outstanding conversational experience. Things we’re working on:

  • 💬 Deliver the most memorable chatting experience — You’ll work on making Mo the obvious choice when it comes to asking a health question. It means having a world-class snappy and delightful chatting experience, blazing fast time to answer, and rich content shared.

  • 🧱 Integrate Mo with Alan services and our healthcare system — You’ll work on integrating Mo with our other services (digital chat with HP, map of physical location of HPs, tailored prevention programs, …) to help members get from words to actions.

  • ➕ Extend our architecture to support the next chapters of Mo — You’ll work on our architecture, and agentic framework, to support Mo’s next needs (get more context, use new skills, be accessible in other countries we operate in)

If you’re excited by the idea of building the future of healthcare, this is the team for you - we're at the start of the journey. If you’re curious, here is a paper we published recently.

🎯 Is it you we’re looking for?

We’re looking for Product engineers with 3+ years of experience who get excited about building state-of-the-art AI systems and applying them to real-world, high-stakes problems in healthcare.

  • You’ll work at the frontier of LLMs, multi-agent architectures, and human-in-the-loop learning — and see your work deployed in production, helping real people.

  • You’ll implement new capabilities for Mo, working across engineering, data, and medical expertise

  • You'll have deep product ownership over the use cases supported in Mo, making sure we actually help our members get and stay better.

  • You’ll have significant influence on system architecture and code quality

  • You’ll mentor engineers, contribute to our product & engineering culture, and help build the team (including participating in hiring, shaping our interview loops, etc.).

You would be a good fit in Mo if most of this sounds like you:

  • Applied background in software engineering and systems architecture

  • Experience with traditional ML, or LLMs, or ML dev ops is a big plus.

  • Product-minded: you want your solutions to be used, and impactful

  • Self-directed, pragmatic, driven, hard working

  • Humble and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!)

  • Collaborative, enthusiastic about teamwork, learning, and teaching

  • Fluent in English (no need to speak French!)

  • Ex-founders are typically great fit in our team

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus.

🤘 How we do it ?

We benefit from Alan’s platform, infrastructure, distribution, and health expertise — but operate with the speed and focus of a startup. If you’re curious about Alan’s broader vision, our Shareholder Letters are worth a read.

People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work, such as:

How we work: our Leadership Principles

  • Mission is the Boss — We think long-term and are methodical optimists who take risks, seeking our mission's success above all else.

  • Distributed Ownership — Accountable enlightened despots: everyone owns their decisions and results.

  • Radical Transparency — All information is accessible and written-first, so everyone can make the best decisions asynchronously.

  • Always Growing — Direct, positive, and caring feedback, combined with self-growth ownership.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

jobs.descriptionPlain:
🤖 WHO WE ARE

We’re building Mo — a health companion for everyone.

We’re a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise. We are building Mo, an intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up on care.

Imagine giving every person in the world instant, 24/7 access to personalised medical expertise - through chat, voice, or video. That’s what we are building 🤖.

We kicked off the project in 2023, and we have launched Mo to all our french members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe.




🚀 WHAT KEEPS US UP AT NIGHT

We’re building a medical agent that works — reliably, safely, and at scale.

You’ll work at the intersection of product engineering, ML engineering, and medical expertise. Our mission is to build the most accurate and reliable medical agent in the world, while delivering an outstanding conversational experience. Things we’re working on:

 - 💬 Deliver the most memorable chatting experience — You’ll work on making Mo the obvious choice when it comes to asking a health question. It means having a world-class snappy and delightful chatting experience, blazing fast time to answer, and rich content shared.

 - 🧱 Integrate Mo with Alan services and our healthcare system — You’ll work on integrating Mo with our other services (digital chat with HP, map of physical location of HPs, tailored prevention programs, …) to help members get from words to actions.

 - ➕ Extend our architecture to support the next chapters of Mo — You’ll work on our architecture, and agentic framework, to support Mo’s next needs (get more context, use new skills, be accessible in other countries we operate in)



If you’re excited by the idea of building the future of healthcare, this is the team for you - we're at the start of the journey. If you’re curious, here https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.12808 is a paper we published recently.





🎯 IS IT YOU WE’RE LOOKING FOR?

We’re looking for Product engineers with 3+ years of experience who get excited about building state-of-the-art AI systems and applying them to real-world, high-stakes problems in healthcare.

 - You’ll work at the frontier of LLMs, multi-agent architectures, and human-in-the-loop learning — and see your work deployed in production, helping real people.

 - You’ll implement new capabilities for Mo, working across engineering, data, and medical expertise

 - You'll have deep product ownership over the use cases supported in Mo, making sure we actually help our members get and stay better.

 - You’ll have significant influence on system architecture and code quality

 - You’ll mentor engineers, contribute to our product & engineering culture, and help build the team (including participating in hiring, shaping our interview loops, etc.).

You would be a good fit in Mo if most of this sounds like you:

 - Applied background in software engineering and systems architecture

 - Experience with traditional ML, or LLMs, or ML dev ops is a big plus.

 - Product-minded: you want your solutions to be used, and impactful

 - Self-directed, pragmatic, driven, hard working

 - Humble and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!)

 - Collaborative, enthusiastic about teamwork, learning, and teaching

 - Fluent in English (no need to speak French!)

 - Ex-founders are typically great fit in our team

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus.




🤘 HOW WE DO IT ?

We benefit from Alan’s platform, infrastructure, distribution, and health expertise — but operate with the speed and focus of a startup. If you’re curious about Alan’s broader vision, our https://www.notion.so/alaninsuranceShareholder Letters https://alan.com/en/blog/discover-alan/a/alan-2025-q3-letter-to-shareholders are worth a read.

People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values https://alan.com/about/company-culture that guide our approach to work, such as:




HOW WE WORK: OUR LEADERSHIP PRINCIPLES

 - Mission is the Boss — We think long-term and are methodical optimists who take risks, seeking our mission's success above all else.

 - Distributed Ownership — Accountable enlightened despots: everyone owns their decisions and results.

 - Radical Transparency — All information is accessible and written-first, so everyone can make the best decisions asynchronously.

 - Always Growing — Direct, positive, and caring feedback, combined with self-growth ownership.




🙌 PERKS & BENEFITS https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

 - Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

 - Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.

 - All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and noise-canceling headphones.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🐼 Who we are

You. Better. With Alan.

Alan's vision is to make prevention the new norm of care for all. Our mission is to help people live in good health to 100 while helping employers feel proud, turning health benefits from a cost centre into their most valuable investment.

We're building a vertically integrated health partner that seamlessly unites insurance and smart healthcare delivery into one system.

By connecting all aspects of care - private, public, and direct to consumer - we create the most member-centric healthcare experience. Through deep engagement, we empower everyone to overcome day-to-day health obstacles and live healthier lives.

We partner with 35K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 950K+ members, and have reached 680M+ in ARR.

Our team of 700+ people (still growing) operates across France 🇫🇷, Spain 🇪🇸, Belgium 🇧🇪, and Canada 🇨🇦

🤘 How we do it ?

People joining Alan are always surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work, such as:

🎯 What drives us — We're obsessed with helping our members live healthier

  1. Mission is the Boss: long-term thinking, seeking our mission success above all else.

  2. Member & customer-led: obsessively focused on solving members & customers problems and creating the most delightful experiences.

🏆 How we build excellence — We hire the best people and give them platform to succeed

  1. Champions of excellence: extremely high standards and talent density.

  2. Distributed ownership: accountable enlightened despots, everyone owns their decisions and results.

  3. Radically transparent: all information is accessible and written-first, so everyone can make the best decisions asynchronously

🤝 How we grow together — We help each other improve through honest feedback and bold thinking

  1. Optimistic alchemy: optimists who collaborate with genuine care and support teammates.

  2. Empathetic challengers: direct, caring feedback combined with praises to help each other grow professionally

  3. Bold & creative contrarians: think differently to achieve greatness, try new approaches

⚡ How we move fast — We fight complexity and focus on what matters most

  1. Disciplined in execution: taking decisive actions with focus that compounds success over time

  2. Fight for simplicity: only high impact processes, smart frugality

👉 About the role

Product designers at Alan are at the forefront of building our product(s), taking them from inception to completion. They work hand in hand with product managers, researchers, and engineers to ensure we create meaningful and human experiences that improve the health of our members.

The community of designers is vibrant and inclusive; we are all learning, growing, and improving together!

As a product designer, you will:

  • Develop a product vision and enable teams to explore, ideate, and experiment towards it. When required, you should be able to autonomously take product bets from zero to one.

  • Communicate transversally and be a compelling storyteller, employing written visual and verbal techniques.

  • Build an understanding of our members to nurture product thinking and transform insights into actionable opportunities.

  • Maintain strong working relationships and collaborate with product managers, researchers, and engineers, from identifying problems and opportunities to finding solutions and delivering the product(s).

  • Develop and evangelize design understanding and sensibility across the organization, improving ways of working and design processes.

  • Mentor junior designers, increasing collective performance and quality across the team.

  • Deliver a UI consistent with Alan’s brand with thoughtful design choices and a high-quality bar in delivering products.

  • Contribute to the design system with components documentation for designers and engineers.

  • Evaluate and maintain the quality of Alan’s product through continuous monitoring and testing.

✏️ Qualifications

  • Based in (or within commuting distance of) one of our hubs (Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Brussels, Madrid, or Barcelona), with the ability to work onsite twice per week.

  • 5+ years of product design experience - You've designed and built products from concept to launch

  • Track record of shipping quality products - You're experienced working within cross-functional product and engineering teams to deliver exceptional user experiences

  • Design mentorship experience - You've coached and guided junior designers, helping them grow their skills and careers

  • Full-stack design expertise - You have proven skills across UX research, UI design, and visual design, with the ability to deliver production-ready assets that developers can implement seamlessly

  • Embrace of AI and other innovative tools - You're curious about and experienced with leveraging AI-powered design tools and emerging technologies

  • Strong English communication - You're fluent in English and can collaborate effectively with our international team (French is a plus but not required)

🙌 Products or teams you may work on

You'll be designing the direct touch points that connect our members with their healthcare journey. Your work will focus on:

  • Alan Play: staying healthy should NOT feel like work. That was our thesis when we launched Play two years ago. The idea was simple: make daily prevention acts fun and rewarding. Since then, 70 000 members per week (!!) take one extra step for their health: a quick meditation, a brisk walk, a back pain exercise, or even a sprint against Kylian Mbappé... But it's only the beginning. The future of play will be more holistic, more personalized, and more social.

  • Alan Clinic: When prevention alone is not enough, our members need the best care possible. That's what the Alan Clinic is for. 120 health professionals (and one AI) work behind the scenes to answer all our member's questions, consult in video, redirect you to the nearest hospital, interpret your lab results. And while it feels effortless for members, the logistics behind it are next level. We plan to grow the clinic further in the best medical suite of tools for both members and doctors.

  • Alan Spain: We're building Alan's own health network from scratch in Spain, designed around the real needs of Spanish members: from navigating a fragmented system to accessing the right care at the right time. At the heart of it is Alan Flex, our subscription model that goes beyond insurance to become a true health companion for individuals and families.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to integrate your professional and personal life best.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - ****it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🤹 Operations at Alan

Behind Alan's performance lies an Operations team that is anything but back-office. At Alan, Ops is a strategic function: we define the vision, build the systems, and own the outcomes that make our insurance and healthcare products work at scale.

As a Senior Ops & Product Builder, you will own some of the most critical and ambiguous challenges in the company. You will shape strategy, drive cross-functional alignment, and build solutions with lasting impact on Alan's P&L and member experience.

You’ll be joining 80+ talented, committed, passionate Ops team members working globally on all our services. You’ll be among the team mates structuring this community.

Want to learn more about Ops at Alan? Read how we work and hire and watch our team in action

⭐️ The challenges

We are looking for a driven professional and entrepreneur with a strong operational background to step into our Customer Enablement Ops team: transforming the way insurance is administered at scale. Our goal is to make Alan the benchmark employer benefit, seamless for every HR admin and genuinely loved by employees, as we grow internationally .

 

The job description is simple: you set the vision, make the hard calls, and own the outcome. Here are some examples of past missions that you could lead:

  • Owning financial performance and building a global recovery engine: Tracking billing KPIs and recovery rates across our markets and establishing the right controls to catch trends and gaps early. Then going further: building the assets and partnerships that actively drive costs down, including designing a global recovery system that scales across countries and adapts to local legislation, and can be deployed when Alan enters a new market. With millions invoiced every month and high growth, the impact on P&L is direct.

  • Making employee management as simple and automated as possible so our admins can cover their members efficiently whatever their setup. From building a DSN-based automated affiliation system, to scaling software integrations or bulk file import systems, making sure that whatever the channel or country, it just works. Deciding which flows to automate first, when to deploy AI, what to build in the product as well as building the monitoring infrastructure to run it reliably at scale.

  • Supporting Alan's growth by scaling operations for its largest deals: As Alan bids on its biggest accounts, making the call on whether and how Ops can absorb the incoming volume. Understanding which capabilities need to be built first, when to externalize, when to leverage AI, what resources are needed. Aligning Sales, Product, and Finance to make it happen.

⭐️ If you have some of the following, you may be a great fit ⭐️

  • You have at least 10 years of professional experience in Operations management or entrepreneurship

  • You are fully fluent in English and Spanish or French or Dutch

  • You have a high level of structure and strong analytical skills (including Sql fluency for data analysis)

  • You independently own high-ambiguity, high-impact initiatives (typically >10M€/year business impact)

  • You excel at defining a clear vision and roadmap on your scope, lead product reviews, and drive make-or-buy decisions

  • You make hard prioritization calls with partial information and manage key external partnerships autonomously

  • You are a thought leader and implement innovative uses of AI and automation across crews

  • You are a strong mentor: you make the people around you better, and you drive significant community impact

For this role we are looking to hire within the E-F level range based out of France, Belgium or Spain.

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

 

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

 

You want to know more about Alan?

  • 🙌 Perks & Benefits: Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

  • 🤘 A strong culture: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work

⭐ The People Growth role

Are you excited about operating, designing and scaling efficient HR operations in a fast-growing company? Join our vibrant People team as People Ops!

  • This role has a strong operational dimension. It calls for a genuine appetite for analysing available Learning and Development data, building efficient and automated processes that will still hold up in ten years, and a sharp understanding of both business strategy and culture. It also requires the ability to understand and work with a wide range of stakeholders. In practice, it means scaling our training policies and processes, and running programmes such as the Coaching Academy (see more here).

    • Below is an overview of the role's key missions.

    • All of those missions cover all the countries in which Alan operates (Belgium 🇧🇪 , Canada 🇨🇦 , France 🇫🇷 and Spain 🇪🇸 ) and also employees under employment of record.

    • The People Growth will be mentored by Aude Vantyghem, who leads these topics at Alan.

    `

    The People team

    • The People team is made up of 11 people who are lucky enough to work in an environment shaped by Alan's Leadership Principles. Every single one of them is a genuine fan of our products and deeply committed to Alan's health mission.

    • It is a generalist team: everyone shares three core missions, namely People on-call, individual situation management, and HRBP. On top of that, each person owns one or more cross-functional topics depending on their flavour.

    • The team covers Learning and Development, Payroll and Admin, Employee Experience and Operational Efficiency, Compliance and Employment Law, and Comp and Ben.

    Your Missions

    On top of the core missions shared across the People team, you will be responsible for:

    • Writing clear, user-centric documentation on our key processes and policies

    • Streamlining and simplifying operations wherever you spot an opportunity

    • Automating recurring processes — at our scale and pace, manual or one-off solutions simply do not hold up

    • Leveraging AI to multiply the impact of your work

    • Making data-driven decisions: analysing available Learning and Development data to guide priorities, measure impact, and continuously improve what we build

    • Scheduling, running, and continuously improving our training programmes for Leads and Coaches, and measuring their impact

    • Contributing to scaling our Coaching system

    • Gradually taking on individual situation management, with full training and support along the way

    • Progressively supporting Leads and Coaches at Alan (check out our unique management system), with training and support along the way.

     

    Outcomes within your first months in the team

    By 2.5 months:

    • You are autonomous in answering day-to-day requests from Alaners through our on-call system

    • You have documented or improved documentation on one People Growth process or policy

    • You have shadowed and been reverse-shadowed on individual situation management

    • You are able to run our training programmes end-to-end, from scheduling to collecting satisfaction data

    • You have taken our automation training and shipped one automation

    • You are able to run basic internal ops recurring tasks

    By 5 months:

    • You handle simple individual situations without supervision

    • You have maintained data quality across your People Growth scope and flagged structural improvements to existing processes

    • You are driving continuous improvement on at least one training programme, using data to guide your decisions

    • You have started contributing to scaling our Coaching system, with growing autonomy

    Is it what you are looking for?

    You may be a great fit for this role if:

    • At least a first experience in HR — recent graduate profiles with an internship are welcome

    • Fluent in English, written and spoken — all our internal processes, documentation, and communications are in English

    • Based in Paris (Valmy) or in one of our physical offices

    • A genuine interest in Learning and Development, training coordination, or People Growth

    • Personal methods to prioritise and adapt when workload or context shifts

    • Rigorous, with rock-solid attention to detail

    • Autonomous: you share a way forward when you spot a problem, while knowing when to ask for guidance on more complex situations

    • A demonstrated appetite for data: you are comfortable working with numbers, spotting trends, and using insights to make decisions

    • A demonstrated interest in automating and improving recurring processes, not just executing them

    • AI-enthusiastic: you actively look for opportunities to leverage tools to amplify your work

    • Comfortable interacting with a wide range of people, including senior stakeholders, both internally and externally

    Nice-to-have

    We are not looking for all of the below - any one of these backgrounds can be a strong signal depending on your routing.

    • You have prior experience in HR ops, even as an intern or work-study.

    • You come from a tech start-up or scale-up background.

    • You have experience in operations, project coordination or office management.

    • You have a background in consulting, audit, legal, compliance, finance or operations.

    • You have a background in teaching.

    For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the A1-B0 level range.

🌍 How we work

  • Location: You must be legally eligible to work from France.

  • Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration
