jobs.descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🎥 The Video Creative Job

Video is core to Alan’s content strategy for 2026 and beyond. We're building a content engine that turns Alan into a recognisable, culturally relevant brand on the future of health, not a generic insurance company. The Video Creative role sits inside the Brand team and works closely with Social, Content, Design, and AI Ops to turn Alan into a brand people actively love and follow.

We're looking for a hands-on, social-native Video Creative. Someone who can invent, edit, design formats, and build a scalable distribution system. You'll architect repeatable, recognisable formats that compound over time, and the production workflows that turn one production into dozens of touchpoints across platforms and markets.

You'll have real ownership over what gets made and how it scales. Social is something you master: hooks, retention, opening frames, captions, thumbnails. You know why people stop scrolling, and you build for that.

Your primary success goal is to grow Alan's brand reach and awareness through video. You'll own format creation and the distribution engine in sync with our Social Media team: defining what we make, how often, for which platforms, and how each piece is sliced and re-served to maximise reach. You'll track performance by format and channel (retention, saves, shares, comments, engagement rate), double down on what compounds, and kill what doesn't.

What you'll do:

  • Design formats that scale. Build recurring, recognisable formats (interviews, series, member stories, behind-the-scenes) with a clear POV, a defined look, a cadence, and a distribution plan from day one.

  • Edit with a social-native craft. Cut shorts, long-form, podcasts, and brand pieces with a sharp instinct for hooks, retention, pacing, and thumbnails — 45-second cuts that hold and 20-minute episodes that get clipped.

  • Build the distribution engine. Turn one production into many outputs across formats and languages, with the workflows and templates to publish at volume without losing quality.

  • Turn what we already have into more. Repurpose existing content (events, brand films, member stories) into formats native to TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn. One asset should become five.

  • Use data to inform what to make next. Read performance signals (retention, saves, shares, engagement) with the Social team to sharpen the next round — data informs the work, the algorithm doesn't dictate it.

  • Use AI to move faster, not lower the bar. Plug into our pipeline (Scenario, Remotion, ElevenLabs) to remove repetitive work, prototype, localise, and scale — without lowering the craft bar.

You'll work closely with the Brand crew, Social Media Manager, Design team, and AI Ops, and partner with local marketing teams in France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada to make sure our formats travel and adapt across markets.

🌟 Is it you we're looking for?

Must-haves:

  • 4+ years experience in video production or content creation, with a strong reel of social-native work

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and French

  • Strong editing craft: expert in at least one tool (Premiere, Final Cut, DaVinci, CapCut), with a sharp sense of pacing and sound design.

  • Social-native understanding: you think in hooks, retention, and thumbnails, and you know what makes someone stop scrolling.

  • Format creation: you've designed recurring shows or formats from scratch and can explain why they worked.

  • Distribution-first mindset: you plan cutdowns and platform variants before the shoot, not after.

  • Lean shooting: solid camera and lighting fundamentals; you can run a small shoot solo or with one assist.

  • Data-aware: you use performance signals to decide what to make next, without letting the algorithm dictate the work.

  • AI-curious mindset: fast to experiment with AI tools to remove repetitive work and scale output without lowering the bar.

  • Based close to Paris, to document key events and behind-the-scenes moments

  • Strong ownership mentality with focus on shipping

  • Collaborative across brand, design, social, and external talent

Nice-to-haves:

  • On-camera presence: comfortable hosting, presenting, or being the face of recurring formats. Unlocks a whole category of content if you have it.

  • Podcast production experience (video and audio)

  • Hands-on experience with gen-AI video, voice, music, or image tools

  • Motion, 3D, or post-production skills (After Effects, Cinema 4D, Blender)

  • Knowledge of Spanish or Dutch

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1/D level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

As Alan scales internationally (800+ employees, 100+ healthcare professionals, 5+ countries), we need an IT Digital Workplace & Endpoint Specialist to manage device security, SaaS platforms, identity & access, and employee IT experience while contributing to build projects that reduce operational toil. You'll work within the IT Community with guidance from senior teammates, growing into autonomy and ownership over time.

Location: Paris-based — You'll work from our Valmy office 3+ days per week, with flexibility for remote work on other days.

First 2 months

  • Join IT oncall rotation (helpdesk) with buddy/shadowing support

  • Discover Alan's processes, stack (Kandji, Apple Business Manager), SaaS ecosystem, and identity tools (Google Workspace, SSO)

  • Handle most typical IT operations issues autonomously (equipment, SaaS access, account provisioning)

First 6 months

  • Handle IT oncall shifts autonomously (40 to 60% of your work days) — solve most problems that do not require engineer input

  • Own onboarding/offboarding workflows end-to-end

  • Have wide knowledge of Alan's processes, equipment, and tools

  • Contribute to “build” projects (MDM improvements, compliance documentation, self-service tooling) with guidance from senior teammates

First year

  • Be regarded as an expert on at least one topic beyond the oncall rotation (e.g., MDM, SaaS admin, compliance documentation)

  • Contribute on device compliance improvements (MDM, EDR, FileVault) across all countries

  • Ship automation or self-service projects that measurably reduce IT toil — with limited guidance

  • Lead low to medium IT projects end-to-end

3 years

  • Fully autonomous on the User Experience & Platform workstreams

  • Lead medium to high-complexity IT projects end-to-end

  • Mentor newer team members, reduce bus factor through documentation and knowledge sharing

👥 Who we’re looking for

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the B0-B1 level range.

Must-have — Technical/hard skills:

  • 1-3 years IT operations experience (or strong internship/student association background in a tech environment): Device management (MDM — ideally Kandji, Jamf, or Intune), SaaS administration, basic identity & access management (Google Workspace, SSO)

  • macOS fluency: Comfortable troubleshooting macOS at scale. Understands the Apple ecosystem (Apple Business Manager, DEP enrollment)

  • Operational reflexes: Can triage issues, communicate to users during incidents, and escalate appropriately. Has oncall or production support experience (or equivalent)

  • Documentation mindset: Writes clear, structured documentation. Understands that knowledge trapped in one person's head is a risk

  • Learning velocity: Picks up new tools and processes quickly. Doesn't need to know our exact stack, but demonstrates fast ramp-up capability

Must-have — Behavioral/soft skills:

  • Delivers with attention to detail: Handles run tasks reliably and consistently

  • Raises questions and identifies frictions: Spots problems, flags them, and suggests improvements

  • Takes feedback well and learns fast: Open to coaching, iterates quickly

  • Collaborative and positive: Works well with teammates and other communities

  • Proactive: Identifies what needs doing and proposes next steps (with guidance where needed)

Nice-to-have skills / Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with Kandji specifically

  • Exposure to security compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2) — even just awareness

  • Basic scripting ability (Python, Bash, etc.) or willingness to learn

  • Experience with SaaS vendor management and/or license administration

  • Interest in automation and coding (even from college/school projects)

  • Experience in a fast-growing tech company environment

Languages: Fluent French & English

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.per

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

⭐️ The Account Executive (Metallurgy) job

We’re expanding our Sales team in France and are looking for a ‘full-stack’ Sales person to engage with prospects and turn them into happy Alan customers. You will join a team that mostly focuses on companies from the Metallurgy industry, interacting with everyone from HR executives to CEOs.

Meet Hakim in this article to learn more about makes this segment so interesting for an Account Executive.

Why is this vertical interesting? 

  • Market potential: A vast market with significant structural challenges like digitization, workforce evolution, and economic context.

  • Team readiness: We’ve honed our strategy over the years, and it’s paying off with increasing inbound leads and active field marketing.

  • Passionate team: Our 6-person team is passionate about the sector we address, and the daily learnings from the field enhance this.

  • Growth opportunity: Our economics are among the most solid at Alan, and the addressable market is enormous, offering infinite opportunities for growth.

  • Day 1: We’ve grown from 0 to 10M€ ARR in just 4 years, and we’re ready to scale even further, we’re only at day 1! 

What will you do with us?

You’ll own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. In our Metallurgy Sales team, the average sales cycle is 6 months, dealing with companies ranging from 20 to 300 employees, with an average ARR of 150K€.

At Alan, Account Executives drive deals and close strategic opportunities with prospects. We sometimes handle some customer relationships to ensure the best possible onboarding. You’ll educate prospects, provide inspiring product demos, and onboard key stakeholders, making the transition from prospect to customer seamless.

We expect you to understand and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method ensures the prospect experience is an integral part of the overall Alan customer experience—making it pleasant and delightful for everyone. We expect you to be instructive to prospects (Smart), as well as to define the best personalized high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

You’ll also help us grow and improve as a company, challenging us to enhance our product(s), methods, and strategy, and getting involved in initiatives to expand our customer base.


⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Metallurgy Team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 4 years of experience managing the whole Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. Prospection is a key part of the role;

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English.

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills;

  • Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems;

  • Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building;

  • Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models;

  • Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team;

  • Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1;

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level range.

If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France.


Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

CTO Founder Associates support the CTO and Senior Alaners on top business priorities, such as unlocking new growth, driving alignment on strategy and building new processes/standards internally and externally. It is a unique chance to work on many tasks in a different and non traditional environment.


You will be highly involved in key challenges for Alan, and will be asked to support high added value tasks for Alan.

 
⭐ Detailed missions ⭐

As such, you can’t be exhaustive on the missions you will perform as a CTO FA, as you can be asked to help on almost any subject. 
Possible projects include:

  • Tech: Exploring new technologies and their applications for Alan

  • Artificial Intelligence: Implementing internal solutions that leverage AI to optimize processes

  • Strategy: Contributing to company vision, market analysis, and growth modelling

  • Product: Identifying and exploring strategic opportunities

  • Corporate & Governance: Supporting board packs, legal research, and public affairs

  • Brand & Communication: Developing corporate presence at events and on social media

  • Growth: Coordinating RFPs, supporting marketing and partnerships

  • Recurring tasks: Coordinating the weekly internal communication, supporting the CTO with his weekly social posts, organizing the monthly event gathering all the Alaners, recruiting the next batch of FAs.

  • And many more...

⭐ Key Outcomes ⭐

By the end of the internship period, the intern will have:

  • Created new processes and resources, and contributed innovative ideas to improve Founders Associates team efficiency and autonomy

  • Gained skills to start your own company as a CTO

  • Met incredibly talented and smart people

  • Collaborated with the CTO and other Senior Alaners

  • Interacted with most of Alan’s communities (Engineers, Product, Strategy, Sales, Marketing, Talent)

  • Gained a 360 view of Alan

  • Contributed to at least one strategic company project (new product launch, AI model implementation, etc.).

⭐ Profile & competencies ⭐

  • Analytical sense and critical thinking: FAs possess strong abilities to frame the right questions, objectively analyze problems, and simulate possible outcomes.

  • Business and product sense: FAs need excellent understanding to think at the company level, assess cross-cutting impacts, and make sound decisions in ambiguous situations.

  • Execution and collaboration: The ability to orchestrate and direct people towards objectives is key, given the scope and timeline of work.

  • Versatility and education: given the scope of work, FAs should be able to jump from one topic to another with similar impact.

  • Organization, time management and autonomy: FAs must excel in managing projects precisely and reliably with minimal external assistance.

  • Effective communication: FAs interact with numerous Alaners daily, and therefore need to clearly express their needs, and inspire action in others.

  • Always looking for the extra mile: FAs are expected to deliver tasks quickly and well while proactively proposing new initiatives and anticipating future needs.

  • Growth mindset: you know how to ask for and receive feedback in order to grow as an FA in your early professional life.

  • Fluency in spoken and written English. All our communications are written and in English.

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 
Therefore, we offer:

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

The Business Segment Lead role is made for transversal influence as we operate based on distributed ownership. You will work closely with all teams involved in the success of your segment (Product, Insurance, Sales, Marketing).   • Value proposition and pricing: Our goal is to differentiate our offer from the market. You’ll relentlessly ask yourself: what is the best product offering to become leader in this segment?

  • Go-to-Market strategy: You’ll work both on renewal (account management) and expansion strategy (business development). This will require you to adapt and innovate when it comes to distribution channels, sub-segments, and partners management.

  • P&L ownership & Resources allocation: You’ll own the return on investment of your segment and are in charge of building the case for internal resources allocation based on your P&L.

  • Product trade-off: You’ll work together with product teams in order for us to build the best product based on market insights.

We are currently hiring for each of the 3 following segments:

  • Tech

    • It is Alan’s historical core market.

    • We reached significant market shares in the start-up & SaaS sub-segment.

    • We are building momentum in our consulting sub-segment.

  • Industry

    • It is one of Alan's most significant growth opportunities.

    • This segment encompasses various industries, including: Manufacturing, Wholesale, Textiles, as well as Luxury & Cosmetics.

  • New Segments

    • It gathers several, high potential sub-segments where everything is to be built.

    • We will focus heavily on those new opportunities in the coming years.

⭐️ If you have some of the following, you may be a great fit ⭐️

  • At least 8 years of prior experience leading a business (product category, business segment, etc.)

  • Full working proficiency in French

  • At least advanced level in English

  • An exceptional ability to establish transversal influence

  • Used to analyze and manipulate data to build a 360 degree view of your market

  • A strong business sense while being able to go deep into product considerations

  • Able to articulate clear strategies in spite of complexity/uncertainty

  • A prior experience working with senior leadership

  • You are a generalist self-starter (Vs a specialist of 1 single industry) able to adapt fast and not afraid to go on the field to support your team mates and learn from them

  • You are based in (or willing to relocate to) either Paris, Bordeaux, Lyon, Marseille, Brussels, Madrid or Barcelona.

For this role, we are looking to hire within the E-F level range.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - ****it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. jobs.title: Actuarial Specialist - Belgian Market
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Insurance Team ⭐️

Being part of Alan's insurance community is a great opportunity to have a significant impact on people's health and wellbeing in our multiple countries of operation.

  • We are at the heart of Alan's mission, bringing to the team our technical leadership and expertise on healthcare and death & disability insurance.

  • We work hand in hand with our data scientists, designers, engineers and product managers to build the most differentiating products and provide a delightful experience at a fair price.

  • We build and manage offers for large companies and public institutions with our sales and account management teams.

  • We make sure our portfolio is closely monitored and risks are effectively managed.

  • We also manage our capital, steer our reinsurance strategy and maintain a trusting relationship with our insurance regulators.

⭐️ The Insurance Expert role in Belgium ⭐️

Being an Insurance Expert at Alan in Belgium means being part of a small and talented team currently working on delivering the best experience to our members.

The role of an Insurance Expert at Alan is to:

  • Design and and price insurance offers,

  • Monitor the business and the risks,

  • Help the rest of the team understand the subtleties of healthcare and insurance.

Recent missions include:

  • Contribute to new product design and pricing strategies.

  • Support Sales with insurance expertise to help sign large customers in Belgium.

  • Monitor the portfolio and improve the depth and accuracy of reporting.

  • Document and structure insurance knowledge to up-level the Belgium team.

  • Join the insurance on-call rotation to support internal teams with day-to-day questions.

  • Work with Engineering on tools that create tailored insurance offers at scale.

  • Being part of an insurance community at the global level, with an impact on our organisation, hiring and training across multiple countries.

⭐️ Is it you we're looking for? ⭐️

You may be a great fit for the role if:

  • You combine a scientific background (actuarial sciences, statistics, mathematics or data science) with a first experience or strong interest in insurance (product, pricing, regulatory or analytics)

  • You have strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to translate complex data, business and legal questions into actionable outputs

  • You have a builder mindset: you continuously identify opportunities to improve and scale processes and systems

  • You are willing to deeply change the insurance and healthcare industry and challenge the status quo

  • You communicate in a clear, structured and to-the-point way in English (written and spoken)

For this role, we are looking to hire within the B1-C1 level range.

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

You want to know more about Alan?

  • 🙌 Perks & Benefits: Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

  • 🤘 A strong culture: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work

jobs.title: Médecin généraliste - Téléconsultation (CDI) 🇫🇷
jobs.descriptionHtml:
🐻 Qui est Alan ?

En France, des millions de personnes renoncent aux soins faute de temps, d'accès ou de moyens. Alan est né pour changer ça — en combinant assurance santé et clinique virtuelle dans une seule application pour devenir un vrai partenaire santé.

La Clinique Alan réunit plus de 120 professionnels de santé disponibles 7j/7 : médecins généralistes, sages-femmes, psychologues, kinésithérapeutes, dermatologues, pédiatres, nutritionnistes, infirmières puéricultrices.

Nos membres bénéficient d'une prise en charge véritablement intégrée :

  • 🩺 Téléconsultation vidéo : pour les situations qui nécessitent une consultation médicale en direct

  • 💬 Chat médical : conseils de professionnels de santé, 7j/7, réponse en moins de 30 minutes

  • 🤖 Mo, notre compagnon santé IA : répond instantanément aux questions du quotidien, avec des réponses relues et validées par nos médecins

  • 🎯 Des programmes de prévention (mal de dos, gestion du stress) : guidés et personnalisés

  • 🧘 Alan Play : une approche ludique de la prévention autour de l'activité physique, du bien-être mental et de la cohésion d'équipe

🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Nous recrutons des médecins généralistes à l'aise avec le soin à distance et motivé(e)s pour nous rejoindre sur notre service de téléconsultation. Ce qui compte pour nous autant que vos compétences médicales : votre capacité à créer une relation de confiance à distance, avec bienveillance et sans compromis sur la qualité des soins.

  • ✅ À l'aise avec les outils numériques

  • ✅ Disponible au moins 4h par semaine (horaires flexibles)

  • ✅ Statut salarié

  • ✅ Convaincu(e) que prévention et accompagnement changent vraiment la vie des patients

🙌 Pourquoi rejoindre Alan ?

  • 🏥 Un cadre médical structuré. Vous exercez dans un cadre clair, conformes aux exigences réglementaires et déontologiques, pour des prises en charge cohérentes, harmonisées et sécurisées. Des médecins référents vous accompagnent dans les situations cliniques difficiles, des pairs sont disponibles pour échanger, et vous pouvez solliciter des spécialistes de l'équipe comme dans une vraie structure de soin.

  • ✨ Une médecine de qualité. Grâce au chat médical et à Mo, chaque membre est orienté vers le bon parcours avant même de consulter. Quand une téléconsultation a lieu, elle est vraiment nécessaire. Vous pouvez accorder le temps qu'il faut à chaque patient, sans pression sur le nombre de consultations.

  • 🤖 Co-construire l'avenir de la médecine. Quelle place pour l'IA dans le parcours de soin ? Chez Alan, les médecins sont au cœur de ces réflexions et contribuent à faire évoluer les pratiques.

  • 💰 Des conditions attractives. Nous proposons une rémunération attractive (à partir de 72€/h), une flexibilité d’organisation et l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une communauté médicale engagée, ainsi que la mutuelle Alan prise en charge à 100 % !

⭐️ Medical Lead - Telemedicine ⭐️

Our Health Professionals team embeds clinical expertise across Alan's integrated model to deliver innovative healthcare services with quality, efficiency, and compelling differentiation.

We're scaling Alan's telemedicine offering to become a cornerstone of our integrated model - teleconsultations, medical chat, and AI agents working together to deliver exceptional care.

You'll grow and lead our team of 50+ health -professionals - General Practitioners (GPs), medical specialists, nutritionists, midwives, physiotherapists - across multiple telemedicine offerings and geographies. You will define clinical practices that balance excellence with effectiveness for optimal patient experience, embedding value-based healthcare principles throughout. Day to day, you will collaborate with a dedicated Ops team to monitor and drive excellence of those health services.

The challenges

Lead and develop the team

  • Scale and lead a remote-first team - recruit, onboard, and manage 50+ health professionals (primarily GPs), across geographies, fostering engagement around shared outcomes and integrated care.

  • Establish a feedback culture - shape a medical team where professionals embrace peer feedback and case reviews for continuous improvement, in a supportive and benevolent environment.

  • Establish medical governance and ensure quality & safety - set up clinical committees, case reviews, and incident management. Develop protocols aligned with national guidelines and Alan member first mindset, define appropriate teleconsultation use cases, ensure compliance.

Monitor and improve clinical practice

  • Define clinical practices for integrated care - create telemedicine guidelines that optimize medical quality, patient experience, and cost-effectiveness across the care pathway.

  • Drive outcomes that matter - establish metrics beyond process indicators: health impact, member experience, cost-effectiveness, and specific clinical patterns and contribute to their monitoring and analysis.

Contribute to shaping tomorrow's care

  • Shape AI-augmented practice - collaborate with product teams to integrate AI effectively into clinical workflows

  • Inform care navigation development within Alan - bring clinical expertise to guide patients toward optimal prevention and care pathways across Alan Clinic and external providers

⭐️ If you have some of the following, you may be a great fit ⭐️

Core requirements:

  • Medical degree (GP or relevant specialty), registered with French Medical Council, 5+ years post-qualification experience. Public health or digital health training is a plus.

  • Fluent English and French; third language is a plus

  • Team leadership experience - you've managed medical teams and/or coordinated complex cross-functional projects.

  • Corporate healthcare experience (health tech, insurers, digital health) or public health sector outside hospitals. You grasp business and organizational dynamics, and collaborate naturally with non-medical teams.

  • Digital health & telemedicine experience (Qare, Livi, Doctolib, etc.) with genuine excitement about AI as an enabler of better care

  • Value-based healthcare experience - you've designed care pathways that balance clinical quality, patient experience, GP engagement, and cost-effectiveness in real-world settings. You proactively discuss healthcare economics and resource allocation, seeing thoughtful resource use as essential to good medicine.

How you work:

  • You are entrepreneurial with bias for action - you thrive in fast-moving environments, make decisions with incomplete information, and iterate quickly

  • You are a strong communicator and change leader - you embrace and foster feedback culture, bringing physicians along on change through empathetic challenge

Plus:

  • Experience in integrated care models or health insurance medical operations

  • Track record scaling medical teams in growth environments

  • Familiar with French telemedicine regulatory framework and healthcare system

Experience level: We're looking for physicians with 5-10 years of post-qualification experience

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - ****it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Internship (6 months)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Engineering team ⭐️

In our engineering team, we build the infrastructure, interfaces, and applications to provide first-class service to our members, health professionals, and even ourselves!

Being an engineer at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate engineers, with a lot of product interaction.

We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

Our process is very simple: those who make product decisions are the same ones who build them.

Our stack is Python/Flask, React, React Native, PostgreSQL.

Want to know more? Read this article if you want to discover how life as an Engineer at Alan and this article on our Engineering career path.


⭐️ Is it you we’re looking for? ⭐️

Please note that for this internship, you need to be based in Paris, France, and currently enrolled in your last year of a Master's degree in a university.

You would be a great fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you:

  • You are looking for your 6-month end-of-studies internship and want to start in H2 2026

  • You have prior internship or side-projects coding experience, and have already deployed frontend and backend code to production for real users

  • You are willing to work in Python/JavaScript (but you don't need to have experience with those 2 languages!)

  • You are passionate about building products

  • You are self-starting and humble

  • You are collaborative, enthusiastic about teamwork and learning

  • Fluent in English (no need to speak French!)

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus.

If you want to learn how engineers can grow at Alan, take a look at our Engineering career path.

For this internship, we are hiring at the A2 level of our salary grid.


🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor pages for more info.



You want to know more about Alan?

  • 🙌 Perks & Benefits: Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

  • 🤘 A strong culture: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work

jobs.title: Infirmier(ère) en santé au travail - en centre et à distance
jobs.descriptionHtml:
🐼 Pourquoi Prévenir

Prévenir est un nouveau Service de Prévention et de Santé au Travail Interentreprises (SPSTI) en Île-de-France.

Notre ambition est de repenser la santé au travail pour améliorer l'impact sur la vie des salariés et l'expérience des professionnels de santé, en s'appuyant sur les moyens technologiques d'Alan.

Notre premier centre médical a ouvert ses portes au 117 Quai de Valmy (Paris 10ᵉ) et ce n'est que le début !

👉 Pour en savoir plus sur le quotidien chez Prévenir, c'est ici

💉 Le poste, concrètement

Vous êtes IDEST au sein d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire (médecins du travail, ASST, IPRP) avec laquelle vous co-construisez la pratique de Prévenir. Votre temps se répartit entre :

  • Visites individuelles, en présentiel au centre de Valmy (Paris 10e) et en distanciel, sous protocole de délégation avec le médecin du travail, repérage précoce des situations à risque (désinsertion, RPS, addictions)

  • Actions de prévention en milieu professionnel pendant le tiers temps dédié : interventions individuelles et collectives, webinaires thématiques (TMS, RPS, hygiène de vie, écrans…), supports digitaux, parcours de prévention innovants

  • Innovation et amélioration continue : test et déploiement de nouveaux outils numériques en santé au travail, conseil à l'équipe Prévenir sur les outils et procédures à déployer, contribution à l'optimisation des protocoles, etc.

  • Selon l'expérience : participation à la cellule PDP, prise en charge de visites de reprise et visites à la demande sous protocole de délégation.

Ce qui change vs. un SPSTI classique :

  • Une équipe pluridisciplinaire à co-construire. Vous ne rejoignez pas un service figé : vous participez à dessiner la place de l'IDEST chez Prévenir, les protocoles de délégation avec les médecins, et les passerelles avec ASST et IPRP

  • Des outils numériques co-construits avec vous. Une équipe d'ingénieurs et de designers Alan développe avec les soignants les outils dont ils ont besoin — DMST, parcours de prévention, supports de webinaires, expérimentations IA

  • Le mix présentiel / distanciel pensé comme un atout métier. Vous voyez les salariés et les entreprises sur le terrain quand c'est utile, et vous gardez le temps et les outils pour faire de la prévention de qualité à distance le reste du temps

👤 Le profil recherché

Indispensable :

  • Diplôme d'État d'infirmier·e

  • Formation en santé au travail (DIUST, AFOMETRA ou équivalent)

  • 3 ans d'expérience en santé au travail après DIUST

  • Excellentes compétences en communication et capacité à établir une relation de confiance avec les salariés et les adhérents

Idéalement :

  • Goût pour le travail en équipe pluridisciplinaire et la co-construction

  • Curiosité pour les outils numériques et l'IA appliqués à la pratique soignante

  • Aisance pour animer un webinaire ou un atelier collectif, en présentiel comme en visio

💚 Ce qu'on offre

  • Lieu : 117 quai de Valmy (Paris 10ᵉ) - dans un centre tout neuf, pensé pour la qualité de l'exercice médical

  • Rémunération de 35 000 € à 50 000 € par an, selon profil

  • Plan d'intéressement

  • Télétravail partiel possible

  • RTT

  • Prise en charge du transport quotidien

  • Restaurant d'entreprise

  • Formation linguistique offerte

  • Événements d'équipe réguliers

Pour en savoir plus sur notre politique salariale, c'est ici !

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Insurance Team ⭐️

Being part of Alan's insurance community is a great opportunity to have a significant impact on people's health and wellbeing in our multiple countries of operation.

  • We are at the heart of Alan's mission, bringing to the team our technical leadership and expertise on healthcare and death & disability insurance.

  • We work hand in hand with our data scientists, designers, engineers and product managers to build the most differentiating products and provide a delightful experience at a fair price.

  • We build and manage offers for large companies and public institutions with our sales and account management teams.

  • We make sure our portfolio is closely monitored and risks are effectively managed.

  • We also manage our capital, steer our reinsurance strategy and maintain a trusting relationship with our insurance regulators.

⭐️ The Insurance Expert role in Belgium ⭐️

The role of an Insurance Expert at Alan is to:

  • Design and price insurance offers,

  • Monitor the business and the risks,

  • Help the rest of the team understand the subtleties of healthcare and insurance.

Being an Insurance Expert at Alan in Belgium means:

  • Being part of a talented team working to deliver the best experience to our members.

  • Recent missions include:

    • Build winning products and pricing strategies to unlock new segments

    • Bring insurance expertise to help us sign the largest customers in Belgium

    • Enter new segments like public sector to unlock new growth in Belgium

    • Enhance our portfolio monitoring as it grows in scale and complexity

    • Strengthen our relationship with regulatory bodies and improve our compliance

    • Work with engineers to build tools to create tailored insurance offers at scale

  • Being part of an insurance community at the global level, with an impact on our organisation, hiring and training across multiple countries.

⭐️ Is it you we're looking for? ⭐️

You may be a great fit for the role if:

  • You have 5+ years of experience in the insurance sector, with meaningful exposure to health insurance products (hospitalisation, group insurance, disability or dental)

  • You are fluent in English and French/Dutch

  • You combine a scientific background (actuarial sciences, statistics, mathematics or data science) with practical experience in insurance (product, pricing, regulatory or analytics)

  • You have strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to translate complex data, business and legal questions into actionable outputs

  • You have a builder mindset: you continuously identify opportunities to improve and scale processes and systems

  • You are willing to deeply change the insurance and healthcare industry and challenge the status quo

  • You communicate in a clear, structured and to-the-point way (written and spoken)

For this role, we are looking to hire within the D-F level range.

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

jobs.location: Paris, France; Bordeaux, France; Lyon, France; Marseille, France; Biarritz, France; Nantes, France; Annecy, France
jobs.descriptionHtml:

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Account Executive (Small Businesses) job

Your mission

Join our Small Businesses team targeting companies with 10-30 employees across tech, consulting, and business services, the market segment where Alan has the strongest product-market fit and brand recognition. You'll work in a high-velocity environment with strong conversion rates, and the opportunity to make an immediate impact on hundreds of growing French companies.

What you'll own

  • Full sales cycle: From prospection to closing

  • Strategic relationships: Drive deals and manage key customer relationships

  • Education & demos: Deliver inspiring product demonstrations and guide stakeholders through the evaluation process

The Alan way of selling

We've developed the Alan Smart & Soft selling method:

  • Smart: Leverage precise messaging and materials to educate and inspire

  • Soft: Create tailored, high-touch strategies for each prospect

  • Experience: Deliver a seamless journey that reflects Alan's customer-first approach

Beyond sales

As an Alan team member, you'll:

  • Shape our product evolution

  • Contribute to improving our methods and strategy

  • Participate in growth initiatives

  • Be part of a collaborative team that thinks big

Join us in revolutionizing healthcare through technology and human connection 🌟

Meet Estelle Berdugo one of our Account Executives.


⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Small Businesses Team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 3 years of experience managing the whole Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. Prospection is a key part of the role;

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English.

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills;

  • Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems;

  • Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building;

  • Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models;

  • Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team;

  • Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1;

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the B1-C0 level range.

If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France.


Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. jobs.location: Paris, France; Bordeaux, France; Lyon, France; Marseille, France; Biarritz, France; Nantes, France; Annecy, France
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Alan operates at the intersection of health insurance, prevention, and regulated data. The person in this role owns the security governance and risk posture of a company that handles sensitive health data for 1M+ members, operates under DORA and HDS certification requirements, and is regulated by the ACPR. They work in close partnership with Legal, Internal Audit, and the broader Risk function — this is a collaborative role, not a siloed one.

🛡️ Your mission — Governance, risk & compliance

Own and operate the ISO 27001 ISMS. You are the accountable owner of the Information Security Management System — scope definition, Statement of Applicability, internal audit programme, and management review. You've led at least one full certification or recertification cycle and know what breaks down in the months between audits.

Be the security expert in the room on regulatory and privacy matters — not the owner. Legal leads on DORA, HDS, RGPD, PGSSI-S, and regulatory relationships. Your role is to bring the technical and operational security substance: translating regulatory requirements into controls, flagging implementation gaps, and making sure the security programme holds up when the regulatory team negotiates with the ACPR or ANS.

Run risk as a living programme, in partnership with the broader risk function. You lead security risk cartography using EBIOS RM and ensure it feeds into — and is informed by — the company-wide risk framework. You facilitate risk workshops, produce treatment plans, and bring the security lens to forums where non-security risks are also on the table. You know when a security risk is actually a business risk in disguise.

Own the controls framework, but distribute ownership of controls themselves. You define the framework, set the standards, and track coverage — but the controls live with the teams who build and run the things they protect. You work closely with Infrastructure, Platform, and Engineering to ensure foundational building blocks (identity, network, secrets management, logging) are designed with security requirements embedded, not bolted on. You're a partner to those teams, not an auditor standing over them.

Run audit cycles with rigour, in close partnership with Internal Audit. You manage the security audit programme and coordinate with certification bodies, but you're not operating in a vacuum. You work with Internal Audit to align scopes, avoid duplication, and present a coherent picture of control effectiveness to the board. You've sat in joint audit planning sessions and know how to make that relationship productive rather than territorial.

Manage third-party risk with real teeth. You run vendor security assessments, define contractual security requirements (security annexes, DPAs). You partner with our Risk team, which oversees third-party risk, and own the security dimension.

Bring the health sector context. You understand the ANS framework, CERT Santé requirements, and what it means to handle sensitive health data operationally — not just on paper. You're a useful partner to Legal when the question is "what does this regulation actually require us to do technically?"

Own incident governance and support DORA reporting. You classify and escalate ICT incidents internally, own BCP and DRP governance, and provide the security substance for DORA incident reports.

🚀 What you'll build and who you'll work with

Next-Gen Compliance Framework: ISO 27001, DORA, HDS, NIS2 — multiple regulators, multiple countries, one coherent governance backbone. Build the system that lets Alan scale from 1M to many millions of members without rebuilding compliance every time.

Automated Audit & Evidence Engine: Replace manual evidence collection with scripted pipelines plugged directly into engineering systems. Turn audit cycles from quarterly fire drills into a continuous capability.

Living Risk Cartography: Risk treated as an operational signal, not a static deliverable. EBIOS RM at the core, feeding directly into business and engineering decisions.

You'll work closely with Legal, DPO, Internal Audit, and the broader Risk function — and partner day-to-day with Infrastructure, Platform, Engineering, Product, and Operations. You're the bridge between regulatory complexity and operational simplicity.

⚡ Why this role is special

Direct Impact: You own the trust foundation that lets Alan handle health data for 1M+ members and operate in highly regulated markets. Your work is the precondition for everything else Alan does.

Complex Problems: 4 regulators across 4 countries, sensitive health data, and a regulatory landscape that keeps shifting (DORA, NIS2, AI Act) — to be modeled into a single, coherent control system.

Ownership & Growth: Board and executive exposure, real influence on company-wide risk decisions, and the autonomy to shape Alan's security culture across 800+ people.

🤝 What you will also do — Technical enablement

Automate compliance work wherever possible. You script evidence collection, automate control testing, and connect GRC tooling to engineering pipelines. You've used Python or similar to reduce the manual lift of an audit cycle, and you actively look for the next process to streamline.

Configure and own GRC tooling, not just use it. You can administer platforms like CISO Assistant, ServiceNow GRC, or Archer — designing workflows, building dashboards, and making them actually useful for the teams that feed them data.

Speak cloud governance fluently. You understand shared responsibility in HDS-qualified environments, know what CSPM tools surface and what they miss, and can reason about policy-as-code (OPA, SCP) without needing an engineer to translate.

Read architecture well enough to challenge it. You can review a proposed architecture, identify control gaps in identity, network segmentation, encryption, or logging, and push back credibly in a room of engineers — without pretending to be one.

Interpret vulnerability data and drive prioritisation. You read scan outputs, work with engineering teams to prioritise remediation by business risk rather than CVSS score, and track resolution KPIs over time.

⭐️ Qualifications — Mindset and soft skills

You translate risk into business language. You can brief a board or an audit committee and make them feel informed — not overwhelmed or underwhelmed. You know the difference between a finding that requires an emergency board call and one that belongs in a quarterly report.

You influence without authority. You align Legal, DPO, Risk, Engineering, Product, and Operations on security requirements without creating blockers or adversarial dynamics. People don't avoid you — they come to you early because you make their lives easier, not harder.

You manage programmes with audit-grade rigor. You run structured, traceable roadmaps. You know where every commitment is, who owns it, and when it's due. You escalate proactively and don't let dependencies surprise you.

You build security culture, not compliance theatre. Your awareness programmes land because they're relevant, not because they're mandatory. You foster proportionate risk ownership across the company — the goal is teams making better decisions, not teams checking boxes.

You think in principles when frameworks shift. DORA is live. NIS2 transposition pace varies. The AI Act is arriving. You don't freeze when the regulatory landscape moves — you reason from first principles and adapt without waiting to be told what to do.

🌍 How we work

Location: Paris-based, hybrid. We value in-person collaboration and ask Alaners to be in the office part of the week.

🎯 We hire people, not checklists. If you're excited by this scope but don't check every box, we'd still love to hear from you.

Ownership & Growth: Board and executive exposure, real influence on company-wide risk decisions, and the autonomy to shape Alan's security culture across 800+ people.




🤝 WHAT YOU WILL ALSO DO — TECHNICAL ENABLEMENT



Automate compliance work wherever possible. You script evidence collection, automate control testing, and connect GRC tooling to engineering pipelines. You've used Python or similar to reduce the manual lift of an audit cycle, and you actively look for the next process to streamline.

Configure and own GRC tooling, not just use it. You can administer platforms like CISO Assistant, ServiceNow GRC, or Archer — designing workflows, building dashboards, and making them actually useful for the teams that feed them data.

Speak cloud governance fluently. You understand shared responsibility in HDS-qualified environments, know what CSPM tools surface and what they miss, and can reason about policy-as-code (OPA, SCP) without needing an engineer to translate.

Read architecture well enough to challenge it. You can review a proposed architecture, identify control gaps in identity, network segmentation, encryption, or logging, and push back credibly in a room of engineers — without pretending to be one.

Interpret vulnerability data and drive prioritisation. You read scan outputs, work with engineering teams to prioritise remediation by business risk rather than CVSS score, and track resolution KPIs over time.




⭐️ QUALIFICATIONS — MINDSET AND SOFT SKILLS



You translate risk into business language. You can brief a board or an audit committee and make them feel informed — not overwhelmed or underwhelmed. You know the difference between a finding that requires an emergency board call and one that belongs in a quarterly report.

You influence without authority. You align Legal, DPO, Risk, Engineering, Product, and Operations on security requirements without creating blockers or adversarial dynamics. People don't avoid you — they come to you early because you make their lives easier, not harder.

You manage programmes with audit-grade rigor. You run structured, traceable roadmaps. You know where every commitment is, who owns it, and when it's due. You escalate proactively and don't let dependencies surprise you.

You build security culture, not compliance theatre. Your awareness programmes land because they're relevant, not because they're mandatory. You foster proportionate risk ownership across the company — the goal is teams making better decisions, not teams checking boxes.

You think in principles when frameworks shift. DORA is live. NIS2 transposition pace varies. The AI Act is arriving. You don't freeze when the regulatory landscape moves — you reason from first principles and adapt without waiting to be told what to do.




🌍 HOW WE WORK



Location: Paris-based, hybrid. We value in-person collaboration and ask Alaners to be in the office part of the week.

🎯 We hire people, not checklists. If you're excited by this scope but don't check every box, we'd still love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Médecin généraliste installé(e) - Téléconsultation (contrat freelance) 🇫🇷
jobs.descriptionHtml:
🐻 Qui est Alan ?

En France, des millions de personnes renoncent aux soins faute de temps, d'accès ou de moyens. Alan est né pour changer ça — en combinant assurance santé et clinique virtuelle dans une seule application pour devenir un vrai partenaire santé.

La Clinique Alan réunit plus de 120 professionnels de santé disponibles 7j/7 : médecins généralistes, sages-femmes, psychologues, kinésithérapeutes, dermatologues, pédiatres, nutritionnistes, infirmières puéricultrices.

Nos membres bénéficient d'une prise en charge véritablement intégrée :

  • 🩺 Téléconsultation vidéo : pour les situations qui nécessitent une consultation médicale en direct

  • 💬 Chat médical : conseils de professionnels de santé, 7j/7, réponse en moins de 30 minutes

  • 🤖 Mo, notre compagnon santé IA : répond instantanément aux questions du quotidien, avec des réponses relues et validées par nos médecins

  • 🎯 Des programmes de prévention (mal de dos, gestion du stress) : guidés et personnalisés

  • 🧘 Alan Play : une approche ludique de la prévention autour de l'activité physique, du bien-être mental et de la cohésion d'équipe

🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Nous recrutons des médecins généralistes à l'aise avec le soin à distance et motivé(e)s pour nous rejoindre sur notre service de téléconsultation. Ce qui compte pour nous autant que vos compétences médicales : votre capacité à créer une relation de confiance à distance, avec bienveillance et sans compromis sur la qualité des soins.

  • ✅ À l'aise avec les outils numériques

  • ✅ Disponible au moins 4h par semaine (horaires flexibles)

  • ✅ Statut libéral et installé(e) en France

  • ✅ Convaincu(e) que prévention et accompagnement changent vraiment la vie des patients

🙌 Pourquoi rejoindre Alan ?

  • 🏥 Un cadre médical structuré. Vous exercez dans un cadre clair, conformes aux exigences réglementaires et déontologiques, pour des prises en charge cohérentes, harmonisées et sécurisées. Des médecins référents vous accompagnent dans les situations cliniques difficiles, des pairs sont disponibles pour échanger, et vous pouvez solliciter des spécialistes de l'équipe comme dans une vraie structure de soin.

  • ✨ Une médecine de qualité. Grâce au chat médical et à Mo, chaque membre est orienté vers le bon parcours avant même de consulter. Quand une téléconsultation a lieu, elle est vraiment nécessaire. Vous pouvez accorder le temps qu'il faut à chaque patient, sans pression sur le nombre de consultations.

  • 🤖 Co-construire l'avenir de la médecine. Quelle place pour l'IA dans le parcours de soin ? Chez Alan, les médecins sont au cœur de ces réflexions et contribuent à faire évoluer les pratiques.

  • 💰 Des conditions attractives. Nous proposons une rémunération attractive (à partir de 90€/h), une flexibilité d’organisation et l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une communauté médicale engagée.
